description: A Fragment class for managing market data display in a mobile application, including setup for RecyclerView and observing UI state.

classes.name: MarketsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of cryptocurrencies, allows navigation to details, and observes UI state.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for this fragment and initializes binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up RecyclerView and observes the UI state.

methods.name: setupRecyclerView
methods.description: Initializes the RecyclerView and its adapter.

methods.name: observeUiState
methods.description: Collects UI state from the ViewModel and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: setupSwipeRefresh
methods.description: Sets up the swipe-to-refresh functionality to reload coin data.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up binding reference to avoid memory leaks.
